ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Aug-30-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name and Gender.
Dept. 514, Judge: Ellen Chaitin, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maria Visio #12353

Petitioner Andy Garyvaldy Genao Cedeno present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name and gender were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Brenda Genao Cedeno and change of gender from Male to Female.
Decree Changing Name and Gender was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Aug-23-2012 Reset To Aug-30-12 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 514 For Order To Show Cause
